articles.title: Too Hot to March! D.C. Cancels July 4th Parade
articles.summary: Washington D.C.'s big 250th birthday parade was canceled because of dangerous heat—up to 115°F! Fireworks are still on, but many other events were stopped to keep people safe.

articles.title: Late-Night Soccer! England vs. Mexico Kicks Off at 1 a.m.
articles.summary: England's World Cup match against Mexico will start at 1 a.m. UK time on Monday. Pubs can stay open until 5 a.m., but fans traveling to Mexico City are upset about last-minute changes.

articles.title: The Secret Scramble to Become Britain's Next Prime Minister
articles.summary: Andy Burnham is about to become the UK's new prime minister, but he hasn't even won an election! Behind the scenes, politicians are competing for jobs in his government.
